cards.name: Rabbitgoo No-Pull Dog Harness
cards.badge: Walk · the harness in every dog-park photo
cards.price: $20–$26 by size and colour at the time of writing · Prime Day brought it to $16
cards.buy_if: your dog pulls, slips collars, or you want a handle for curbs and vet scales; it is the four-adjuster harness that fits most dogs on the first try.
cards.skip_if: you have a strong, reactive or escape-artist dog — spend $25–$45 on a three-strap escape-proof harness or a 2 Hounds Freedom instead.
cards.owners: Reported 100,000+ ratings at 4.5 stars. Praise: four adjustment points, the handle, reflective piping, the price. Complaints: armpit rub when worn loose, and buckles on a small share of units.
cards.video_title: How to adjust a Rabbitgoo No-Pull Dog Harness: neck and chest strap adjustment
cards.video_why: The neck and chest sliders are the whole difference between a harness that stays on a spitz-type dog and one that doesn't. Four minutes on exactly those two straps.

buy.pick: Measure the chest just behind the front legs and choose the size that puts that number mid-range. A 50-lb Jindo lands in Large.
buy.check: Sold by the rabbitgoo store or Amazon; "2 leash clips" in the title; pick a colour that's in stock (prices differ by colour).

cards.name: KONG Classic (natural rubber, made in the USA)
cards.badge: Enrichment · the toy vets name first
cards.price: about $8–$16 by size at the time of writing · Large (30–65 lb) sits around $12
cards.buy_if: you want one toy that does crate training, rainy days, separation departures and slow dinners for years, at the cost of a sandwich.
cards.skip_if: your dog shreds rubber — get the black KONG Extreme in the same size, or go up one size; a KONG that can be clamped whole is a KONG that fails.
cards.owners: Praise: nearly indestructible for normal chewers, and a frozen peanut-butter KONG buys twenty quiet minutes. Complaints: ignored unless stuffed, smells if not washed, too small when bought by guess.
cards.video_title: 5 stuffed KONG recipes: how to stuff a KONG dog toy
cards.video_why: Five fillings, easy to hard. The stuffing is the product; an empty KONG is a red doorstop, and the freezer is where the twenty minutes come from.

buy.pick: Large for 30–65 lb dogs (Noeul's size). Between sizes, go up, never down; power chewers get the black Extreme.
buy.check: "Ships from and sold by Amazon.com" or the KONG store; red "Classic" for normal chewers, black "Extreme" for destroyers; the 2-pack is the cheaper per-toy route.

cards.buy_if: you walk a dog: this is the one thing you'll buy every four months for the rest of the dog's life, and the one that must not fail.

cards.video_title: Earth Rated dog poop bags and dispenser: an honest review
cards.video_why: A 2025 owner review of the rolls and the leash dispenser. Watch the tear-off and the thickness; that is the entire purchase decision for a bag.

buy.pick: 270-count unscented on refill rolls (15 a roll, fits any dispenser); add the leash dispenser once, not every time.
buy.check: Tick Subscribe & Save for 5–15% off; sold by Earth Rated or Amazon; unscented unless you already know you like lavender.
